text_block_list.text:
Early December, nearing the end of the 
Senior year. 
We visited the club to take stock of where 
things stood 
following the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Looking closely now, they have 
multiplied. 
The flowers at the club.

Her words were no mere figure of speech. 
In truth, there were far more flowers at 
the club 
than when I first visited. And the reason 
was—

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Look at this! Since Phaleno won a G1 race, 
we planted more flowers again. 
This time, they're cosmoses!

In other words, this sight of the club 
overflowing with flowers 
—was proof of the brilliant trail her 
hooves had left behind.
choice_data_list:
It's your achievement. Take full pride in 
it.

It's your achievement. Take full pride in 
it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
To think I have... achieved this much.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet... I did not achieve this alone. 
The club showed devotion. My kin lent 
their aid.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And above all else, you were there.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Let us be proud. —Together.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However... hmm. Though I repaid the club 
with victories, 
to those girls who were part of the trail 
I blazed— 
—I have yet to convey my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, Trainer. 
May I?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno. Thank you for the invitation. 
I just had some grilled bananas, and they 
were exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, is that so? I am glad. 
I hardly think a modest gesture like this 
could 
ever repay all my gratitude to you, 
Hayahide, but—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This is a token of my appreciation. 
Please, accept it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You truly take your debts of 
gratitude to heart.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As for me, the mere fact that you have run 
at the forefront of the Twinkle Series to 
this very day... 
That alone is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to say this in return— 
Thank you for living up to our 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As your family... no. 
As your kin, I couldn't be prouder.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Right, Brian? 
Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You came as well, Brian. 
I am truly indebted to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As the first wall to break my stride, 
and as the inspiration that stoked the 
flames within me— 
—I am truly grateful to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. I didn't do a thing. 
You just used me as fuel of your own 
accord.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So don't go thanking me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Nor do I have any intention of thanking 
you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I see. Even so, 
I wanted to say it to you.

And so, the modest gathering Phalaenopsis 
had arranged 
grew livelier and livelier 
as time went by.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I always watch what I eat in the 
winter, and yet...! 
Phalaeno's mizore hot pot is just too 
delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now~ Once in a while is perfectly 
fine. 
After all, winter is meant for eating warm 
food 
and curling up under the kotatsu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I think I can picture 
all too vividly how you spend 
your winter days.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phalaeno-san! Thank you so much 
for inviting us too—!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Spe. 
Are you enjoying yourself?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The carrot hamburg steak 
was wicked delicious! But, um...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This party is to thank all the horsegirls 
who have looked out for you, right? 
...Did I really do anything for you, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Heh. Have you truly not realized?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You, too, are one of the embers 
that kindled my flame.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I can confess it now—I was jealous of you. 
More than a night or two was spent 
yearning to run just as you do.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You have my gratitude, Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The tracks you wove set this body ablaze. 
Because of that, the one who stands here 
now—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —is the Queen.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!! 
I don't know what to say...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To think my running was able to help 
you... 
Ehehe. It gives me such a warm feeling 
inside!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I hope we might match strides one 
day. 
Naturally, on a GⅠ stage.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If we ever get the chance, 
let's definitely race! It's a promise!

Phalaenopsis would continue to weave her 
future, 
influenced by all manner of tracks along 
the way—
